title: Silver Plus Account specifications and requirements
summary: This document specifies Silver Plus account requirements: $1,000 minimum opening deposit, $2,500 ongoing minimum balance, daily interest compounding, and a Tier 2 balance threshold of $15,000 for higher interest. It also allows 15 free withdrawals per month before possible excess withdrawal fees per the fee schedule.
faqs: What is the minimum deposit required to open a Silver Plus account?
